scripts.build:web: bun build web/src/bootstrap.ts web/src/modeLoader.ts --outdir site/assets --target browser --format iife && mkdir -p site/styles site/assets && cp web/styles.css site/styles.css && cp web/styles/*.css site/styles/ && cp web/coi-serviceworker.js site/coi-serviceworker.js && cp -R web/assets/. site/assets/
scripts.build: bun run compile:demo-world && bun run build:site && bun run build:web
